def wrap_preserve_chars(s, max_chars):
    # Insert line breaks only; retain every original character in order.
    lines=[]
    i=0
    n=len(s)
    while i<n:
        end=min(i+max_chars,n)
        if end<n:
            # Prefer breaking after punctuation or a literal space, while retaining it.
            candidates=[j for j in range(i+max_chars//2,end+1) if s[j-1] in " ，。；：、,.:"]
            if candidates:
                end=candidates[-1]
        lines.append(s[i:end])
        i=end
    return "\n".join(lines)
